title: DNSSEC
on: This zone is signed. Add the DS record below at your domain registrar; until then, resolvers treat the zone as unsigned.
off: Signing lets resolvers check that answers for this domain really come from this server.
registrar: DS records for your registrar (most want the one with digest type 2):
confirmEnable: Sign this zone? Nothing changes for visitors until you add the DS record at your registrar.
confirmDisable: Remove the DS record at your registrar first and wait a day. If it is still there when signing stops, the domain stops resolving. Turn off DNSSEC now?
